a.lede: This Congressional investigation into Nvidia's China sales and its dealings with Trump is the second one, so far, since news of the alleged spy affair broke.
a.title: Democrats launch Nvidia investigation, write scathing letter on Huang’s ‘scheme’ with Trump

b.lede: The US president said he spoke with Jensen Huang on Monday and asked him about the affair with the alleged spy.
b.title: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy
